description: This file defines the CyberArkSecretManager class, a specialized secret manager for interacting with CyberArk Conjur API, including authentication, secret reading/writing, and policy management.

classes.name: CyberArkSecretManager
classes.description: A secret manager class for interacting with CyberArk Conjur API, supporting authentication, secret retrieval, storage, and policy management.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the CyberArkSecretManager, setting up configuration, environment validation, and cache.

methods.name: _authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates with CyberArk Conjur and retrieves a base64-encoded session token, utilizing cache for efficiency.

methods.name: _get_request_headers
methods.description: Constructs request headers including the authentication token for API requests.

methods.name: _ensure_variable_exists
methods.description: Ensures a secret variable exists in CyberArk by creating a policy entry if necessary.

methods.name: get_url
methods.description: Builds the URL for accessing a specific secret in CyberArk Conjur.

methods.name: async_read_secret
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a secret from CyberArk Conjur, with caching and error handling.

methods.name: sync_read_secret
methods.description: Synchronously reads a secret from CyberArk Conjur, with caching and error handling.

methods.name: async_write_secret
methods.description: Asynchronously writes a secret to CyberArk Conjur, ensuring variable existence and updating cache.

methods.name: async_delete_secret
methods.description: Attempts to delete a secret, which is not supported; clears cache and returns a not supported message.
